title: ISEYC Nigeria pilot indicator set
description: A small set of national indicators with full source metadata. Values are retrieved from the cited APIs at runtime. Not ISEYC statistics. Not a substitute for NBS official releases.
operator: Initiative for Sustainable Evolution for Youth and Community (ISEYC)

indicators.title: Population, total
indicators.definition: Total population counts all residents regardless of legal status or citizenship. Values are mid-year estimates.
indicators.methodologyNotes: World Bank aggregates and estimates based on national statistical sources and UN Population Division where applicable. See WDI metadata for full method.
indicators.licence: World Bank open data terms; attribution required.
limitations: National aggregate only — not state or LGA resolution.
Estimates may be revised when new censuses or surveys are released.
ISEYC does not produce this series; we retrieve and display it with attribution.

indicators.title: School enrollment, primary (% gross)
indicators.definition: Gross enrollment ratio is the ratio of total enrollment, regardless of age, to the population of the age group that officially corresponds to the level of education shown.
indicators.sourcePublisher: World Bank — World Development Indicators (underlying UNESCO UIS / national sources)
indicators.methodologyNotes: Gross ratios can exceed 100% when over-age or under-age enrollment occurs. Gaps in years mean the source did not publish a value for that year.
indicators.licence: World Bank open data terms; attribution required.
limitations: Does not measure learning outcomes or facility quality.
Missing years are absent data, not zero enrollment.

indicators.title: Mortality rate, under-5 (per 1,000 live births)
indicators.definition: Probability per 1,000 that a newborn baby will die before reaching age five, if subject to age-specific mortality rates of the specified year.
indicators.sourcePublisher: World Bank — World Development Indicators (UN IGME estimates)
indicators.methodologyNotes: UN Inter-agency Group for Child Mortality Estimation models underpin many WDI child mortality series. See source metadata for model details.
indicators.licence: World Bank open data terms; attribution required.
limitations: National estimate — not a state league table.
Modelled estimates carry uncertainty; do not treat as exact facility counts.
Not a measure of any single health programme's performance.

datasets.title: World Development Indicators
datasets.collectionMethod: Compilation and estimation from national and international statistical systems
limitations: ISEYC retrieves selected series only; the full WDI catalogue is far larger.
